name: Free cluster
description: Noether's theorem, translation and rotation: 300 bodies under pairwise gravity in empty space (written as a potential, so Statistics measures the energy too). Every pair pulls equally and oppositely along the line between them, and the laws are the same everywhere and in every direction: the cluster collapses and churns, yet its total momentum P and its angular momentum L stay constant (Statistics: Momentum and Angular momentum), and the energy holds within the integrator's error. Compare Cluster and a sun (translation broken), Cluster and two suns (rotation too) and Gravity that grows (time).
